minutes.headline: Building committee mapped its work plan and voted to post social media updates; no warrant articles will be filed.
minutes.summary: The committee brainstormed milestones for a roadmap on town buildings, starting with Town Hall and Ritter before TC Passios, including a report review, programming, facility requirements, a timeline and a financial roadmap. It voted to let a member post informational social media updates and discussed outreach. It leaned toward a handout at town meeting rather than a warrant article, and approved old minutes.

what_happened.line: The committee voted by roll call to let a member post informational updates on social media at the committee's instruction.
Members set milestones for a roadmap on town buildings: review reports, facility requirements, programming, timeline and phasing, and a financial roadmap.
The committee decided no warrant article will be filed; a handout or survey at annual town meeting will be discussed at the next meeting.
Brooks House was added to the list of buildings in scope.
The second April meeting was targeted for April 13, and the chair is to invite building reuse committee members to give feedback.

why_it_matters: The committee is setting the order and the financial roadmap for work on Town Hall, Ritter and other town buildings, which will draw on the same debt capacity as other large projects and so bears on future borrowing and tax bills.
With no warrant article planned, residents will not be asked to vote on this at town meeting for now; the committee is looking at a handout or survey for outreach instead.
